build_dinov2_linear_depther: build a DINOv2 linear depth estimation model with pretrained weights for monocular depth prediction
build_dinov2_dpt_depther: build a DINOv2 DPT depth estimation model with pretrained weights for monocular depth prediction
create_vit_large_linear_depther: create a ViT-Large linear depth model using dinov2_vitl14_ld with NYU or KITTI pretrained weights
create_vit_giant_dpt_depther: create a ViT-Giant2 DPT depth model using dinov2_vitg14_dd for high-accuracy monocular depth estimation
get_depth_range_for_weights: get the min and max depth range tuple for NYU or KITTI pretrained weight configurations
